tessera:automaton1d:invalidInit: init must be a vector of length width.
tessera:automaton1d:invalidRule: rule must be an integer in the range [0, 255].
tessera:automaton1d:invalidSize: width and generations must be positive integers.
tessera:count:invalidN: n must be a positive integer.
tessera:diamond_square:invalidN: n must be a positive integer (the field side is (2^n)+1).
tessera:dla:invalidObstacles: obstacles must have the field size.
tessera:dla:invalidSeeds: seeds must be an N-by-2 matrix.
tessera:erode:invalidHeightfield: heightfield must be a non-empty numeric matrix.
tessera:gameoflife:emptyGrid: grid must be a non-empty matrix.
tessera:gameoflife:invalidGenerations: generations must be a non-negative integer.
tessera:gameoflife:invalidGrid: grid must be a numeric or logical matrix.
tessera:halton:invalidDims: dims must be an integer in the range [1, 16].
tessera:invalidRegion: Region must be a 4-element vector [xmin xmax ymin ymax].
tessera:invalidSize: Size must be a positive scalar or a [rows cols] vector.
tessera:invalidSize3: Size must be a positive scalar or a [rows cols planes] vector.
tessera:julia:invalidConstant: c must be a complex scalar or a [real imag] vector.
tessera:maze:invalidSize: rows and cols must be positive integers.
tessera:poisson_disk:invalidArgs: width, height and radius must be positive.
tessera:turtle:invalidCommands: commands must be a character vector or string.
tessera:wfc:invalidSample: sample must be a non-empty numeric matrix.
tessera:wfc:sampleTooSmall: sample must be at least N x N.
